name: Pre-skill warm-up
description: Gets wrists, shoulders, core and hips ready for calisthenics skill work such as handstands and levers. Needs a stick and a pull-up bar.

items.cue: Start small and grow the circles.
Straight arms, control the whole range.
Spread the fingers and rock with control.
Fingers back, ease into the stretch.
Arms locked, move only the shoulder blades.
Pull the shoulders down from the ears, arms stay straight.
Move with your breath through the whole spine.
Low back pressed down, ribs in.
Sink the hips, then rotate and reach.
Heels down, rock gently in the bottom.
Push the floor away, shoulders open.
